scenes.title: CHATGPT IS DOING ONE TINY THING
scenes.say: Every ChatGPT answer is one tiny trick, repeated over and over. What is it?
scenes.chat: Sure! Here is a short poem about the ocean, written one piece at a time...

scenes.title: PAUSE AND GUESS
scenes.say: Googling, guessing, or copying? Pause and guess.

scenes.sub: one little piece at a time
scenes.say: It's B. It guesses the next bit of text. Then the next. Then the next.

scenes.title: First it reads a giant pile of text
scenes.say: First it reads a giant pile of text and learns which words usually follow which.

scenes.title: Text gets chopped into tokens
scenes.label: AVG: 1 TOKEN ≈ 3/4 OF A WORD
scenes.say: Then it chops text into tokens. Long words get cut into pieces. On average, one token is about three quarters of a word.

scenes.title: Example: it scores every option
scenes.say: Type 'the sky is', and it scores every possible next token. Blue wins, so blue gets added. Then it does it all again.

scenes.title: A bit of random on purpose
scenes.say: Then it adds a little randomness on purpose. That's why the same question can get a different answer every time.

scenes.label: tokens GPT-3 learned from
scenes.src: Brown et al. 2020, Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
scenes.say: GPT-3, an older model, learned from about three hundred billion tokens.

scenes.title: IS THAT REAL THINKING?
scenes.say: So is that real thinking, or just insanely good guessing? Comment yes or no.
